6814-the-curlytops-at-uncle-frank-s-ranc.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. "No, she isn't hurt, I guess," Jan answered, feeling of her doll's head. "I forgot all about her being in my lap. Oh, aren't you going to play any more, Ted?" she asked as she saw her brother toss the big coat on a chair and take off the spectacles.

arxiv-1611-01573.title: Null Angular Momentum and Weak KAM Solutions of the Newtonian 𝑵 \boldsymbol{N} -Body Problem
arxiv-1611-01573.creator: Boris A. PERCINO-FIGUEROA
arxiv-1611-01573.description: A 2016 arXiv research paper by Boris A. PERCINO-FIGUEROA. 213 (2014), 981–991] it has been proved that in the Newtonian N N -body problem, given a minimal central configuration a a and an arbitrary configuration x x , there exists a completely parabolic orbit starting on x x and asymptotic to the homothetic parabolic motion of a a , furthermore such an orbit is a free time minimizer of the action functional.

arxiv-1906-02658.title: Quantum rifling: protecting a qubit from measurement back-action
arxiv-1906-02658.creator: Daniel Szombati, Alejandro Gomez Frieiro, Clemens Müller, Tyler Jones, Markus Jerger, Arkady Fedorov
arxiv-1906-02658.description: Abstract Quantum mechanics postulates that measuring the qubit’s wave function results in its collapse, with the recorded discrete outcome designating the particular eigenstate the qubit collapsed into. We show this picture breaks down when the qubit is strongly driven during measurement.

arxiv-1910-13998.title: Adapting Multilingual Neural Machine Translation to Unseen Languages
arxiv-1910-13998.description: Abstract Multilingual Neural Machine Translation (MNMT) for low-resource languages (LRL) can be enhanced by the presence of related high-resource languages (HRL), but the relatedness of HRL usually relies on predefined linguistic assumptions about language similarity. Recently, adapting MNMT to a LRL has shown to greatly improve performance.

arxiv-2104-12977.title: SE-DAE: Style-Enhanced Denoising Auto-Encoder for Unsupervised Text Style Transfer
arxiv-2104-12977.creator: Jicheng Li, Yang Feng*, Jiao Ou
arxiv-2104-12977.description: Abstract Text style transfer aims to change the style of sentences while preserving the semantic meanings. Due to the lack of parallel data, the Denoising Auto-Encoder (DAE) is widely used in this task to model distributions of different sentence styles.

arxiv-2303-15784.title: Ideograph: A Language for Expressing and Manipulating Structured Data
arxiv-2303-15784.creator: Stephen Mell, Osbert Bastani, Steve Zdancewic
arxiv-2303-15784.description: Abstract We introduce Ideograph, a language for expressing and manipulating structured data. Its types describe kinds of structures, such as natural numbers, lists, multisets, binary trees, syntax trees with variable binding, directed multigraphs, and relational databases. Fully normalized terms of a type correspond exactly to members of the structure, analogous to a Church-encoding.

arxiv-2405-11662.title: Hyperbolic enhancement of a quantum battery
arxiv-2405-11662.creator: C. A. Downing, M. S. Ukhtary
arxiv-2405-11662.description: Abstract A quantum system which can store energy, and from which one can extract useful work, is known as a quantum battery. Such a device raises interesting issues surrounding how quantum physics can provide certain advantages in the charging, energy storage or discharging of the quantum battery as compared to their classical equivalents.

arxiv-2409-13871.title: Generalized representative structures for atomistic systems
arxiv-2409-13871.creator: James M. Goff, Coreen Mullen, Shizhong Yang, Oleg N. Starovoytov, Mitchell A. Wood
arxiv-2409-13871.description: Abstract A new method is presented to generate atomic structures that reproduce the essential characteristics of arbitrary material systems, phases, or ensembles. Previous methods allow one to reproduce the essential characteristics (e.g., the chemical disorder) of a large random alloy within a small crystal structure.

arxiv-2410-02826.title: LinkThief: Combining Generalized Structure Knowledge with Node Similarity for Link Stealing Attack against GNN
arxiv-2410-02826.creator: Yuxing Zhang, Siyuan Meng, Chunchun Chen, Mengyao Peng, Hongyan Gu, Xinli Huang
arxiv-2410-02826.description: Abstract . Graph neural networks (GNNs) have a wide range of applications in multimedia. Recent studies have shown that Graph neural networks (GNNs) are vulnerable to link stealing attacks, which infers the existence of edges in the target GNN’s training graph.

arxiv-2410-21270.title: Strategic Electric Distribution Network Sensing via Spectral Bandits
arxiv-2410-21270.creator: Samuel Talkington, Rahul Gupta, Richard Asiamah, Paprapee Buason †, Daniel K. Molzahn
arxiv-2410-21270.description: Abstract Despite their wide-scale deployment and ability to make accurate high-frequency voltage measurements, communication network limitations have largely precluded the use of smart meters for real-time monitoring purposes in electric distribution systems. Although smart meter communication networks have limited bandwidth available per meter, they also have the ability to dedicate higher bandwidth to varying subsets of meters.

arxiv-2505-22997.title: Theoretical Foundations of the Deep Copula Classifier: A Generative Approach to Modeling Dependent Features
arxiv-2505-22997.creator: Agnideep Aich, Ashit Baran Aich, Bruce Wade
arxiv-2505-22997.description: Abstract Traditional classifiers often assume feature independence or rely on overly simplistic relationships, leading to poor performance in settings where real-world dependencies matter. We introduce the Deep Copula Classifier (DCC), a generative model that separates the learning of each feature’s marginal distribution from the modeling of their joint dependence structure via neural network-parameterized copulas.

arxiv-2506-17600.title: A novel fast short-time root music method for vibration monitoring of high-speed spindles
arxiv-2506-17600.creator: Huiguang Zhang, Baoguo Liu, Wei Feng, Zongtang Li
arxiv-2506-17600.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Huiguang Zhang, Baoguo Liu, Wei Feng, Zongtang Li. Ultra-high-speed spindle bearings challenge traditional vibration monitoring due to broadband noise, non-stationarity, and limited time-frequency resolution. We present a fast Short-Time Root-MUSIC (fSTrM) algorithm that exploits FFT-accelerated Lanczos bidiagonalization to reduce computational complexity from 𝒪 ⁡ ( N 3 ) \mathcal{O}(N^{3}) to S ​ N ​ log 2 ⁡ N + S 2 ​ ( N + S ) + M 2 ​ ( N + M ) SN\log_{2}N+S^{2}(N+S)+M^{2}(N+M) while preserving parametric super-resolution.

arxiv-2511-07519.title: Jet quenching in out-of-equilibrium QCD matter Preprint: CERN-TH-2025-140
arxiv-2511-07519.creator: João Barata, Kirill Boguslavski, Florian Lindenbauer, Andrey V. Sadofyev
arxiv-2511-07519.description: Abstract We present the first study of jet substructure modifications during the bottom-up evolution that describes the early stages of heavy-ion collisions. To this end, we study the bremsstrahlung radiation rate of soft gluons from a hard parton propagating through out-of-equilibrium QCD matter.

europmc-pmc10772178.description: Ischemia-reperfusion (I/R) injury paradoxically occurs during reperfusion following ischemia, exacerbating the initial tissue damage. The limited understanding of the intricate mechanisms underlying I/R injury hinders the development of effective therapeutic interventions. The...

pmc-11710314.title: Differential Roles of Human Tau Isoforms in the Modulation of Inflammation and Development of Neuropathology
pmc-11710314.creator: Brian Spencer, Jennifer Ngolab, Aaron Schueler, Daniel Sung, Robert A Rissman
pmc-11710314.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundAlzheimer’s disease (AD) is the most common tauopathy and characterized by the progressive accumulation of Aß and tau. Tau is expressed in two major isoforms containing either 3 or 4 c‐terminal repeats labeled as 3R and 4R tau. While these two isoforms occur in roughly equimolar ratios in AD, most research focus and mouse models of tau center only the 4Rtau protein and not 3Rtau.

pmc-12640067.title: Frailty Among Patients With ADPKD
pmc-12640067.creator: Jui Wang, Szu-Ying Lee, Chia-Ter Chao, Kuo-Liong Chien, Chih-Kang Chiang, Kuan-Yu Hung, Jenq-Wen Huang
pmc-12640067.description: IntroductionAutosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease (ADPKD) is a major inherited cause of end-stage kidney disease (ESKD), associated with various systemic complications. Frailty, a degenerative condition linked to adverse health outcomes, may be influenced by ADPKD and its complications; however, data on this association is limited. This study investigated whether ADPKD is associated with increased risk of incident or worsening frailty.

pmc-12699623.title: Mental health in patients with rheumatoid arthritis and axial spondyloarthritis: a cross-sectional, case–control tertiary centre study from Czechia
pmc-12699623.creator: Marketa Husakova, Veronika Balajkova, Karel Pavelka, Ladislav Senolt, Karolina Kuchaříková, Pavel Mohr, Jan Kotrs, Marta Olejárová
pmc-12699623.description: AbstractObjectivesTo evaluate the mental health burden in rheumatoid arthritis (RA) and axial spondyloarthritis (axSpA) using diagnostic and self-reported tools and to examine its associations with current disease activity, patient-reported outcomes and barriers to appropriate care.DesignSingle-centre, cross-sectional, case–control study.SettingRheumatology centre of a tertiary care hospital, serving as a referral clinic with outpatient and inpatient care in Czech Republic.

pmc-12787692.title: Gut Symbiont-Driven Adaptive Evolution of Herbivorous Insect–Plant Interactions and Its Ecological Implications
pmc-12787692.creator: Junming Li, Yaqi Yu, Lovemore Zulu, Nan Xu, Yanxue Pan, Wenze He, Xunyue Liu, Qiong Rao
pmc-12787692.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The interaction between plants and phytophagous insects is one of the most complex relationships in ecosystems. By acting as direct third-party participants, gut symbionts redefine this binary antagonistic relationship. This article reviews the roles of gut symbionts in the adaptive evolution of phytophagous insects, highlighting their important roles in degrading plant secondary metabolites, modulating plant defense responses, promoting insect nutrient absorption, and shaping immune phenotypes.

pmc-12821385.title: Nitrogen-Doped Carbon Quantum Dots Enhance In Vitro Fertilization and Early Embryo Development by Improving Sperm Activation in Mice
pmc-12821385.creator: Hyunhee Song, Jae-Wan Jung, Hoon Jang
pmc-12821385.description: Nitrogen-doped Carbon Quantum Dots (NCQDs) exhibit distinctive optical properties and potential bioactivity in mammalian systems. However, their effects on reproductive cells remain poorly understood. To clarify their role in gamete function and embryo development, the present study examined the influence of NCQDs on sperm activation, fertilization, and early embryo development in vitro using a mouse model.

pmc-13075473.title: NHC-catalyzed asymmetric synthesis of natural products and pharmaceutical drugs
pmc-13075473.creator: Afifa Shahid, Samreen Gul Khan, Muhammad Jawwad Saif, Ameer Fawad Zahoor, Bushra Parveen, Aqsa Mushtaq, Asim Mansha, Arif Mermer, Aijaz Rasool Chaudhry, Ahmad Irfan
pmc-13075473.description: Asymmetric processes catalyzed by N-heterocyclic carbenes (NHCs) have become extremely important as strategic tools for the efficient synthesis of bioactive molecular scaffolds. Over the past few years, these catalysts have been widely employed for the total synthesis of pharmaceutical drugs and structurally distinct natural products.

pmc-13436124.title: Central nervous system antituberculosis drug exposures in a rabbit model of tuberculous meningitis
pmc-13436124.creator: Jose M. Calderin, Sean Wasserman, Rosleine Antilus-Sainte, Melissa Cristaldo, Narineh M. Odjourian, Faye Lanni, Firat Kaya, Noha Abdelgawad, Juan Eduardo Resendiz-Galvan, Matthew Zimmerman, Veronique Dartois, Paolo Denti, Martin Gengenbacher
pmc-13436124.description: Treatment optimization through pharmacokinetic evaluation is needed to improve outcomes in tuberculous meningitis (TBM). Clinical assessment of drug penetration into the central nervous system (CNS) is limited to cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) sampling, which may not reflect drug exposures at the site-of-disease. We characterized the pharmacokinetics of antituberculosis drugs in CNS tissues using a rabbit model of TBM.

pmc-13617233.title: Developmental Care and Follow‐Up of Infants Exposed to Alcohol and/or Drugs in Utero: An Australian Benchmarking Survey
pmc-13617233.creator: Marla Laverie, Catherine Clark, Millicent Cram, Angelique Brandt, Kelly J. Bower, Anna Tottman, Rochelle Lester, Julianne Pegler, Alicia J. Spittle, Amanda K. L. Kwong
pmc-13617233.description: AimInfants exposed to alcohol and/or drugs (AoD) in utero are at considerable risk for developmental complications which are amenable to early intervention. There are no published guidelines in Australia for the allied health care of infants and toddlers (0–2 years) who have been exposed to AoD in utero.
